Klasse TestByteArrayLocator

java.lang.Object
net.sf.jguiraffe.locators.TestByteArrayLocator
public class TestByteArrayLocator extends Object
Test class for ByteArrayLocator. This class also tests functionality of the base class.

    • testGetURLDifferentData

      public void testGetURLDifferentData()
      Tests creating URLs from different input data. The URLs should differ. Because the URLs are created based on hash codes it is not guaranteed that two distinct data arrays cause different URLs. So we try multiple times.
